description: Polygon PoS checkpoints from the Heimdall API: the latest K checkpoints (1 to 10) with their Bor block range, timestamp and proposer, plus the average spacing in blocks and seconds. Checkpoints are the Ethereum-anchored root commitments. State-sync logs are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
